title: 140. Gas Station

examples.explanation: Starting at station 3 allows a complete circuit without running out of fuel.
No starting station can complete the circuit (total gas < total cost).
Starting at station 0, there is enough gas (5) to cover the cost (4) and complete the circuit.

hints: A circuit is impossible when total gas is less than total cost.
Track the running fuel balance from a candidate start while scanning the stations once.
If the balance becomes negative at station i, no station from the current candidate through i can be a valid start, so try i + 1.
